text: Test navigation menu display in mobile version (burger menu instead of horizontal)
Change browser window size to 375px width and verify correct scrolling
Rotate device to landscape and portrait, ensure page element adaptivity
Tap product card on mobile — verify popup with details opens
Verify that on screens smaller than 500px logo and buttons stack vertically
Simulate swipe-left on product — add to favorites option appears
Touch-scroll table: ensure horizontal scrolling works on iPhone
Test adaptive image loading: different versions load on retina/budget phones
When pinch-to-zoom scaling interface doesn't break, all buttons accessible
Show/hide 'Back to top' button when scrolling long page on mobile
Verify CTA buttons are at least 44x44px for comfortable tapping
Test sticky header: fixed panel visible on mobile devices when scrolling
Tab switching with swipes: swipe right — next content appears
Test system keyboard appearance when activating input field on mobile
Toggle dark theme on device — app should adapt to system
Test call-to-action button position on all popular sizes (320, 375, 480, 768 px)
When running on tablet: menu opens from left side as slider
Verify multi-touch gestures (pinch and double-tap) don't interfere with basic navigation
Modal window closes with swipe down on mobile
Product cards in mobile grid arranged 2 per row instead of 4 like desktop
Test that when launching Progressive Web App icon displays correctly and splash screen is adaptive
Scrollbar doesn't overlay content during horizontal scrolling in landscape mode
Verify tooltip appears on long tap for text copying
Test that special navigation drawer variant appears when running on Android
On iOS tap 'Share' button invokes system sharing menu
Test transparent status bar display on Android devices
Using custom soft keyboard: verify no input field overlap
When Wi-Fi disabled switch to offline mode and ensure PWA page reports feature unavailability
Test push notification display on iOS with granted permissions
